Terminal Workspace — reviewed third-party components
Prepared 26 November 2026

ConnectBot termlib 0.3.15
https://github.com/connectbot/termlib
Apache-2.0.txt and termlib-NOTICE.txt

libvterm, vendored revision 847 in termlib 0.3.15
https://www.leonerd.org.uk/code/libvterm/
libvterm-MIT.txt and libvterm-wcwidth-NOTICE.txt

JSch maintained fork 2.28.8
https://github.com/mwiede/jsch
JSch-BSD.txt

JZlib and jBCrypt code retained by the selected JSch artifact
JZlib-BSD.txt and jBCrypt-ISC.txt

Kotlin standard library and parcelize runtime 2.4.21
Apache-2.0.txt and Runtime-Apache-NOTICES.txt
The standard library also contains derived ThreeTenBP and Boost code:
Kotlin-ThreeTenBP-BSD.txt and Kotlin-Boost-1.0.txt
GWT/Guava Apache license texts in the selected Kotlin release are identical
to Apache-2.0.txt; their attributions are retained in Runtime-Apache-NOTICES.txt.

kotlinx.coroutines core JVM / Android 1.10.2
Coroutines-Apache-2.0.txt

kotlinx.serialization core JVM 1.7.3
Serialization-Apache-2.0.txt and Runtime-Apache-NOTICES.txt

SLF4J API 2.0.20
SLF4J-MIT.txt (no logging provider added)

AndroidX, Compose, Room, Material and remaining reviewed Apache runtimes
Apache-2.0.txt and Runtime-Apache-NOTICES.txt
This includes packaged AndroidX graphics-path 1.1.0 native code as well
as the termlib native code listed above.

Complete copied license and permission texts for the identified components
above are included in this directory. provenance.json identifies inspected
source/artifact origins, scope and copied text fingerprints.

The earlier debug APK's selected notices and runtime graph were inspected.
This expanded source bundle still requires a new APK inclusion check and
final release runtime/native/resource/NOTICE reconciliation before release.
License compliance and security verification are separate reviews.
